notes: A new Plex library next to the old one. Settings → Show info → Switch a Plex library to info files → New library … makes a second Plex library with Plex's NFO agent over the folders you pick, and leaves the old library exactly as it is (its details, matches and watched marks). Shows get AniBox's details there as their info files are ready. Per new library: Ready X of Y, 'Show Plex the ready shows' (refreshes only the shows that became ready since last time) and 'Copy watched marks …' from the old library (preview first, nothing is written before Restore). Undo in the History removes the new library again. Delete the old library in Plex yourself once everything is there.
